title: a16z Podcast: How Technology Is Changing Investing

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: As people begin to gain access to information that was previously left to only trained specialists.
reader_summary.overview: As people begin to gain access to information that was previously left to only trained specialists. But if investing (and most decision making, in fact) is about navigating uncertainty. Recorded at a16z's Summit event in November 2017, John Fawcett, CEO of Quantopian and Joshua Levin, co-founder and chief strategy officer of OpenInvest discuss.
